summary: Austin, Texas, software engineer, extensive experience in DevOps and cloud infrastructure, strong expertise in AWS, passionate about infrastructure as code, active in tech communities, interest in RPGs, particularly Dungeons & Dragons, married for nearly 20 years, no children, thyroid cancer survivor, has lived in Brussels, Belgium, and previously worked in Cupertino, California, prefers using virtual credit cards for online transactions, critical of corporate practices regarding employee treatment, advocates for privacy and security in technology.
